name: FlyingPosters-TS-TW
title: FlyingPosters
blurb: Images rotate and distort as you scroll, creating a flowing 3D carousel.
description: WebGL component rendering images as rotating 3D planes on a scroll-driven carousel. Uses shader-based distortion and easing to create smooth, responsive transitions responding to wheel, touch, and drag input.
use_when: Showcasing a gallery with a premium, interactive 3D aesthetic and smooth scroll responsiveness.
avoid_when: Performance-critical contexts — runs continuous WebGL rendering and requires a sized parent.
a11y: Purely visual scroll-driven carousel; no keyboard navigation or prefers-reduced-motion guard.
